I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-random, confirming the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats.

I didn't do anything else, since Ilse said no action was needed. I didn't open #north-team or their earlier post there. I didn't edit anything in the brain or other records either, so "noted" just means I've acknowledged it here. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Ilse posted it in this channel, so it was fine to repeat it there.
